title: Cross Symbol: Copy & Paste ✝ Latin Cross (Christian Cross)
meta_description: Copy and paste the Latin cross (✝, U+271D), the main symbol of Christianity — plus Orthodox, Maltese, and other crosses, and how it differs from the dagger † and the ✗ X mark. Click any symbol to copy it.
hero_tagline: The Latin cross (✝) — the central symbol of Christianity — along with the Orthodox, shadowed, and Maltese crosses it is grouped with, and the dagger † and X marks it is often mistaken for. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: The cross symbol (✝, Unicode U+271D LATIN CROSS) is the best-known symbol of Christianity: an upright cross with a longer lower arm, the shape traditionally tied to the crucifixion. Unicode places it in the Dingbats block alongside a family of related crosses, and with an emoji variation selector it renders as the ✝️ cross emoji. It is a different character from the multiplication and cancellation X marks (✕ ✗) and from the typographic dagger (†), even though the four are frequently swapped for one another.
